scheme_name: AGR 2 (Farm Mechanization) Scheme Of Farmers Other Than SC/ST)
other_conditions: The beneficiary must be a permanent resident of Gujarat state.
The beneficiary must be a farmer who is not classified as SC or ST.
The farmer must reside in talukas where the Submissions on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM) scheme has NOT been implemented (i.e., outside the 208 talukas where SMAM is active).
The purchase must be made from an authorized manufacturer listed in the panels prepared for periodic prize discovery by the Agriculture department.
benefits_summary: Provides financial assistance for the purchase of agricultural equipment, with higher assistance for small, marginal, and women farmers.
